title: Pick the right KPI
instructions: Three quick questions about campaign metrics.

questions.prompt: Which KPI best measures the **efficiency** of an acquisition campaign?
questions.context: Think about what ties spend directly to results.

options.explanation: CPA tells you what each result costs.
CTR measures ad relevance, not cost efficiency.
Followers say nothing about acquisition cost.

questions.explanation: Efficiency is about outcomes per unit of spend. CPA divides spend by the number of acquisitions, which makes it the most direct efficiency metric.
questions.hint: Efficiency metrics usually have the word *cost* in them.

questions.prompt: Select every metric that is calculated from **spend**.
questions.explanation: CTR is clicks ÷ impressions; it never looks at spend. The other three all divide or multiply by spend.

questions.prompt: A campaign has a CTR of 4% and a conversion rate of 0.5%. What is the most likely issue?

options.text: The ads are not relevant to the audience
The landing page is not converting visitors

questions.explanation: A high CTR shows the ads work. A very low conversion rate means visitors leave after clicking, which points to the landing page.
